HTTP Router DSL

Provides a Jester/Sinatra-style macro DSL for defining HTTP routes.

Usage: let app = router: get "/": respond 200, "Hello World" post "/users": let data = body() respond 201, "Created: " & data get "/users/{id}": let userId = pathParams"id" respond 200, "User: " & userId

Macros

macro router(body: untyped): untyped
Define routes using a DSL. Returns an HttpHandler. 
macro routerObj(body: untyped): untyped
Define routes using the DSL and return a Router object. Useful when callers need route introspection, mounting, or manual composition.
